snippet.title: Pigeon Simulator | Out Now on Xbox Series X|S and Gamepass Ultimate | 4 Player coop extraction chaos
snippet.description:
Pigeon Simulator is out now on Xbox Series X|S and available with Game Pass!  https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9nrhqlzx3900 

The pigeons have come home to roost… but something’s not right in New Squawk City.

Anomalies are spreading, and it’s up to the elite Paranormal Examination & Kontainment (P.E.K.) Unit to clean up the mess.

Team up with up to 3 other pigeon agents in this SCP-inspired co-op adventure to locate, identify and extract the dangerous anomalies that have begun to terrorise the city.

Swoop into Pigeon Simulator today on Xbox Series X|S and PC with Game Pass!

https://discord.gg/Hj3hqR9wQf
https://x.com/ThePigeonSim
